primary_content.text: Melbourne Awnings is a premier retractable awning and sun shade system company, bringing you the best in custom fitted outdoor awnings, retractable roofs, external awning blinds, canopies and outdoor sun roofs. As trusted retractable awnings suppliers, you can rely on us to provide the best retractable awning, custom pergola canopy or other option to suit your property.
Discover Our Range Of Outdoor Awnings In Melbourne

Are you looking for high-quality retractable or fixed awnings Melbourne customers love? Then you’ve come to the right place. At Melbourne Awnings, we’ve been providing the best external blinds and awnings for domestic and commercial properties for over 35 years, giving us a unique understanding of what you need for any situation.

For manual or automatic external awnings in Melbourne, we’ve got you covered. From patios to rooftops, gardens to windows, we have the best selection around because we’ve learned how unpredictable the weather can be in Melbourne; sun one moment and rain the next. To make sure you have every opportunity to enjoy your outdoor area, we’re here to offer the very best in custom awnings for your property, including custom patio sun shades, custom door awnings, custom balcony shades and other custom shade systems.

Waterproof awnings in Melbourne have proven to be very popular among our customers, as many know how quickly the rain can arrive, but there are also plenty of choices of materials, colours and styles available – including transparent external awnings that provide an unblocked view, as well as durable exterior canvas awnings.
Browse our website to learn more about our all weather awnings in Melbourne, or for more in-depth knowledge or assistance, contact our team or speak to us today by calling (03) 9595 9099.
Custom External / Outdoor Awnings

Outdoor awnings in Melbourne have multiple uses. Not only do they protect you from adverse weather such as the rain, but they can also provide cover from the sun. As a bonus, outdoor window awnings in Melbourne are great for managing the temperature of your home or outdoor area, blocking some of the heat from entering and keeping you that bit cooler – and it helps with energy costs, too!

For something a little more unique, we can help with custom awnings for Melbourne customers. Whether you have a small or tricky space or you’re just after something unique like an extendable shade in a certain colour, speak to our experts and find out what we can do to help.
Window Shade Awnings

Window shade awnings or sun awnings mostly cover your windows from the outside. Their biggest benefit is protecting you from direct sunlight or rain, meaning you can leave your windows open during either. With a window or balcony sun shade, your home is protected from the elements while allowing a refreshing breeze inside, helping you manage the heat and save on energy.

Our window and balcony awning options are durable enough to withstand anything the weather throws at them, making them a solid investment while also adding character and style to your property. It’s no wonder why the popularity of window shade house awnings in Melbourne is on the rise.
Retractable Outdoor Shade Awnings
Retractable outdoor awnings are a very popular choice. They give home and business owners the final say over when they’re needed, providing quick protection from the elements.

A retractable shade awning can be manually or electronically operated depending on your preference, making it more convenient for you. You can also get electric canopies and awnings to fit a range of spaces and areas. Look no further than us for a retractable awning in Melbourne. Whatever your needs may be, we’re positive we can help find the most suitable extendable shade solution.
Outside Blinds In Melbourne

At Melbourne Awnings, we have a fantastic range of external blinds and awnings Melbourne customers love to show off. As with our other outdoor products, these are designed to protect your home from the weather – both hot and cold – and help you manage the temperature without appliances adding to your energy bills, while also keeping fresh air circulating.

External awning blinds are growing in popularity, especially on large windows that let a lot of light in, which can be disruptive. The option to raise and lower them on demand means you have complete control over your home’s patios and awnings regardless of the weather.

To learn more about our available options for external sun shades and awnings for outdoor areas, contact Melbourne Awnings today. Whether you’re after custom porch awnings in Melbourne, modern window awnings or a balcony awning in Melbourne, we’ll be happy to advise you of the most suitable shade systems for your property.
Turn Your Patio Dreams Into Reality

To speak with one of the leading awning suppliers, get in touch with our office on 0395959099 or send us an email today. We’d love to help you renovate your outdoor area with our high-quality awnings and outdoor shades in Melbourne.

primary_content.text: WHAT TYPES OF OUTDOOR AWNINGS DO YOU OFFER?

We offer a wide range of outdoor awnings, including retractable outdoor awnings, waterproof awnings, window shade awnings, balcony shades and custom-fitted solutions. Whether you need sun protection, rain coverage or temperature control, we have options suitable for homes and commercial spaces alike.
CAN I CUSTOMISE THE AWNINGS TO FIT MY SPACE & STYLE PREFERENCES?

Yes, we specialise in custom awnings tailored to your space and design preferences. If you have a unique architectural layout or want a specific colour or fabric, we’ll work with you to find the ideal fit. Our team can help create exterior canvas awnings, modern canopies and more that suit your property perfectly.
ARE YOUR RETRACTABLE AWNINGS AVAILABLE IN ELECTRIC OPTIONS?

Yes, we offer our retractable awnings in both manual and electric options for your convenience. Electric awnings offer easy operation with the touch of a button and can be a great addition to patios, windows, balconies and commercial outdoor areas. We can help recommend the right control system for your chosen space, ensuring a reliable, user-friendly solution
